stage: the no-control route, arm A1 — I2V from a start frame rendered from the GLB
registered_by: executor seat, on E11-nocontrol, before the first submission of any E11 graph
how_these_were_chosen: The date as a plain integer with a run index appended, continuing the rule specs/E08-seeds.json, specs/E09-A3-seeds.json and specs/E10-seeds.json use: 2026-08-12, runs 31, 32 and 33. The property that matters is that all three numbers are fixed BEFORE any result is seen, and a date-derived seed is checkable against this file's own git timestamp. None was drawn from a prior run, from any served template, or from anything this seat had already looked at.

allocation.2026081231: the probe — the one generation this spec authorises up front
allocation.2026081232: reserve, spendable only on a named cause the probe surfaces

wave_2_allocation.recorded_by: executor seat, on E11-nocontrol, BEFORE the first submission of any wave-2 graph and committed ahead of it
wave_2_allocation.the_named_cause: Two defects the Director's eye named on the wave-1 probe, both ruled fixable and both dispatched as wave 2: (1) a large uncommanded push-in — the horizon found on 4 of 65 frames and never again — against which consult #7's WanCameraEmbedding/WanCameraImageToVideo pair is the licensed counter; (2) the motion reading as a drunken wobble rather than a dance, which his diagnosis attributes to the bar language pulling the performance toward it. The reserve's condition — 'spendable only on a named cause the probe surfaces' — is met by both, and the advisor's ruling R3 recommended exactly this spend.
wave_2_allocation.why_not_a_fresh_registration: This list already binds in both directions: an experiment that pre-registered seeds MUST use one of them. Registering a new number for wave 2 would leave a registered seed unspent while the run drew from outside the committed list, which is the second clause's defect wearing a receipt. So wave 2 draws 2026081232 — a number fixed on this file's git timestamp, before wave 1's result existed, let alone wave 2's.

remaining_after_wave_2.2026081233: reserve, unspent, same condition — the ceiling's second reserve, spendable only on a named cause wave 2 surfaces and the Director's word

wave_2_allocation.SPENT_ON_WAVE_3: 2026081233 was spent on wave 3 — see wave_3_allocation below. The ceiling is now exhausted: 3 of 3.
wave_2_allocation.the_two_seed_rule_still_binds: Wave 2 runs ONE seed. Nothing it reports about the scene may be written as a property of the route, exactly as for wave 1. Note additionally that wave 2 is a COMPOSED wave — the camera embedding and the prompt surgery move together by the Director's direction — so no observation may be attributed to either lever alone, and the report says so rather than implying a single-variable read.

wave_3_allocation.recorded_by: executor seat, on E11-nocontrol, BEFORE the first submission of any wave-3 graph and committed ahead of it
wave_3_allocation.the_named_cause: Wave 2's generation was spent on a graph that could not have worked: WanCameraImageToVideo fed a camera embedding to the plain Wan 2.2 I2V experts, which have no channel for it, and returned 65 frames whose subject survived one frame. The advisor's E11 w2 ruling R5 dispatches wave 3 as the corrected wave 2 on this last reserve. The cause is named, mechanical, and now refused in-tool by Gate PAIR, whose red test is wave 2's exact graph.
wave_3_allocation.what_this_seed_buys_that_wave_2_did_not: The camera lever's FIRST actual test, and the prompt surgery's first actual test. Neither has been measured: wave 2's frames had no subject to judge either on.
wave_3_allocation.the_ceiling_is_now_exhausted: 3 of 3 generations spent (2026081231 wave 1, 2026081232 wave 2, 2026081233 wave 3). There is no reserve left. Any further generation on E11 needs a new ceiling from the Director, and this seat will not assume one.
wave_3_allocation.the_two_seed_rule_still_binds: Wave 3 runs ONE seed. Nothing it reports about the scene may be written as a property of the route. Wave 3 is additionally a MULTI-BREAK wave — weights, length, resolution and start frame all move together with the camera lever and the prompt surgery — so its comparison to wave 1 is route-level and no observation may be attributed to any single change. The report says so rather than implying otherwise.
wave_3_allocation.why_not_a_fresh_number: Same clause as wave 2: this list binds in both directions, and an experiment that pre-registered seeds must draw from them. 2026081233 was fixed on this file's git timestamp before wave 1's result existed.

why_the_index_starts_at_31: specs/E09-A3-seeds.json registered 2026081201-02, specs/E08-seeds.json registered 2026081211-13 and specs/E10-seeds.json registered 2026081221-22 on this same calendar day. Reusing any of those numbers would put a seed registered for one experiment onto another, and the record would afterwards have to explain which run a number belonged to. The offset keeps every seed on this rig traceable to exactly one registration.
why_a_new_seed_and_not_E08_s: E11 runs a different model family (Wan 2.2 I2V-A14B, two experts) through a different conditioning node on a differently-shaped latent path, and its high-noise sampler is a KSamplerAdvanced rather than E08's KSampler. The same integer would not reproduce E08's noise field even in principle, so registering a fresh number states that plainly rather than implying a same-seed comparison the route cannot deliver. E10's report records the same rider for the frame-count case.
the_two_seed_reading_rule: E10's closing ruling R3 stands and E11 is read under it from birth: a scene observation from ONE seed is an observation, never a route property. The probe registered here is one seed, so nothing this experiment reports about the scene may be written as a property of the route. The reserves are what a second seed would be drawn from, on a named cause and the advisor's call, not this seat's.
ceiling: 3 generations wave 1 — 1 probe plus 2 reserve on named causes. estimate_credits is recorded before the first submission and both meters are reported; on an all-OSS graph it returns 0 by construction (E08 section 12), so the ceiling is enforced by counting generations. Spent credits have no compensator; the bound is the honest treatment.
binds_in_both_directions: An experiment that pre-registered seeds must use one of them, and an experiment that pre-registered none may not vary its seed at all. tools/armature_core/gates.py::gate_s_seed_registration enforces both clauses at build time and tools/armature_core/route_gates.py::gate_s_registration enforces them again against the graph that is about to run, on the saved file the cloud actually executes.
the_inert_second_seed: The low-noise expert's KSamplerAdvanced carries noise_seed 0 with add_noise=disable. It draws nothing, so it is inert; route_gates.gate_s_registration reports it and does not demand it be registered. Recorded here so a reader of the graph does not find an unregistered 0 and take it for a gap in this list.
